title: Monastery of Sant Jeroni de Cotalba

buildingCutout.basis: The protected monastery’s current mapped perimeter.

terrainReference.basis: Original PNOA national bare-earth position at the paved side of the principal residential range. Foundations follow the surveyed rise and drop around the block.

identities.name: Monastery of Sant Jeroni de Cotalba
identities.address: Monestir de Sant Jeroni de Cotalba, Alfauir, Valencia, Spain

names: Monastery of Sant Jeroni de Cotalba
mapIdentity.scope: Native building multipolygon 3358219 matches the named protected site, Wikidata Q1321720. Traced outer wall lengths, cloister and projecting major bell tower; the Spanish building-height raster controls roof and tower hierarchy.

note: The local published originals show the stone cloister, entrance and battlemented Gothic bell tower. The monastery identifies the church as occupying the south wing, a four-register tower with an arched voice opening on each side, and seven bays on each gallery level.
